LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BasicStorage.label: Digital storage
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BasicStorage.description: Unlock the digital storage system. Build a storage core, and items stored inside it take up no map space, never render and never rot.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest1.label: Auto-ingest I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest1.description: Unlock auto-ingest. The core absorbs loose items across the map without a hauler.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest2.label: Auto-ingest II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest2.description: Raises auto-ingest speed to 5 stacks per 15 ticks.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest3.label: Auto-ingest III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest3.description: Raises auto-ingest speed to 10 stacks per 15 ticks.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel2.label: Core Lv2
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel2.description: Storage core capacity 500 -> 1000 stacks. Applies immediately to every core already built on the map; no rebuild or reload needed.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel3.label: Core Lv3
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel3.description: Storage core capacity 1000 -> 1500 stacks. Applies immediately to every core already built on the map; no rebuild or reload needed.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel4.label: Core Lv4
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel4.description: Storage core capacity 1500 -> 3000 stacks. Applies immediately to every core already built on the map; no rebuild or reload needed.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy1.label: Crafting proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy1.description: Unlock crafting proxy I: the recipes that workbenches within 13x13 can craft are completed by the building itself - orders are placed in the Craft automation panel and the workbenches do not need a bill. Ingredients are taken from a digital storage core and products go straight back into it.\n\nSkill 5, speed 0.8x, 300W plus the draw of every bench in range.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy2.label: Crafting proxy II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy2.description: Unlock crafting proxy II: skill 10, speed 1.0x, same 300W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy3.label: Crafting proxy III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy3.description: Unlock crafting proxy III: skill 15, speed 1.5x, same 300W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy4.label: Crafting proxy IV
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy4.description: Unlock crafting proxy IV: skill 20, speed 2.0x, same 300W.\n\nOverclocking (3/6/9 GHz) multiplies speed by 3/6/9 at 9/27/81 times the power draw.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_MiningProxy1.label: Mining proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_MiningProxy1.description: Unlock mining proxy I: speed 0.8x, skill level 8, 500W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_MiningProxy2.label: Mining proxy II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_MiningProxy2.description: Unlock mining proxy II: speed 1.2x, skill level 15, 1000W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_MiningProxy3.label: Mining proxy III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_MiningProxy3.description: Unlock mining proxy III: speed 2.0x, skill level 20, 2000W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BuildProxy1.label: Construction proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BuildProxy1.description: Unlock construction proxy I: speed 0.8x, skill level 8, 500W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BuildProxy2.label: Construction proxy II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BuildProxy2.description: Unlock construction proxy II: speed 1.2x, skill level 15, 1000W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BuildProxy3.label: Construction proxy III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BuildProxy3.description: Unlock construction proxy III: speed 2.0x, skill level 20, 2000W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CleanProxy1.label: Cleaning proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CleanProxy1.description: Unlock cleaning proxy I: speed 0.8x, skill level 8, 500W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CleanProxy2.label: Cleaning proxy II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CleanProxy2.description: Unlock cleaning proxy II: speed 1.2x, skill level 15, 1000W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CleanProxy3.label: Cleaning proxy III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CleanProxy3.description: Unlock cleaning proxy III: speed 2.0x, skill level 20, 2000W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_GrowProxy1.label: Growing proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_GrowProxy1.description: Unlock growing proxy I: speed 0.8x, skill level 8, 500W. Sows, harvests and cuts plants automatically.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_GrowProxy2.label: Growing proxy II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_GrowProxy2.description: Unlock growing proxy II: speed 1.2x, skill level 15, 1000W. Sows, harvests and cuts plants automatically.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_GrowProxy3.label: Growing proxy III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_GrowProxy3.description: Unlock growing proxy III: speed 2.0x, skill level 20, 2000W. Sows, harvests and cuts plants automatically.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_TranscendentProxy.label: Transcendent proxy
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_TranscendentProxy.descrip: The end of all four proxy chains: one building takes over mining, construction, cleaning and growing (including plant cutting) at once.\n\nSpeed 7.5x, skill level 20, up to 75 simultaneous jobs per work type (300 running at once in total), 6000W.
